title: Longshot
description: A first-person marksman hunt across three open 3D reserves. Your round takes time to arrive and falls on the way, so past the 200 m zero you hold over on the mil-dots and lead anything that runs. Animals notice you by how close you are, how fast you are moving and how badly the scrub is hiding you — crouch in a thicket and stop, and a cheetah at 200 m never knows. Four rifles trade magnification against cycle time and sway, from a light .308 to a 20x anti-materiel gun that wobbles like a gate in the wind. Score is species value times hit zone times range, so one head shot at 500 m beats ten easy ones. Nothing is downloaded: the terrain, the scrub, every animal and every sound is generated at boot.
